title: BPSC TRE 4.0 Day 02 Complete Practice Test (50 Questions)

sections.name: Part II: General Studies & Bihar Special (सामान्य अध्ययन)
Part IV: Class 9–10 Secondary Mathematics (माध्यमिक गणित)

questions.subject: Hindi Grammar
questions.question: Which prefix (Upasarg) is used in the compound word 'Atyant' (अत्यंत)?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The prefix is 'Ati' (अति). Ati + Ant = Atyant (Yan vowel sandhi).

aiDeepSolution.concept: A prefix (Upasarg) is an affix placed at the beginning of a root word. Here, 'i' of Ati combines with 'a' of Ant to form 'y' via Yan Sandhi rules.
aiDeepSolution.trick: Split the word by Sandhi: Ati + Ant = Atyant. Hence the root prefix is 'Ati'.
aiDeepSolution.trap: Candidates often superficially look at the first two letters and pick 'Atya', which is not a standard prefix.

questions.subject: Hindi Grammar
questions.question: Which of the following is an authentic synonym of 'Ratri' (रात्रि - Night)?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: All three words — Vibhavari, Rajani, and Nisheeth — are authentic synonyms of Ratri. Hence option (D) is correct.

aiDeepSolution.concept: BPSC Hallmark 5-Option Question: When two or more options are correct, Option (D) 'More than one of the above' must be chosen.
aiDeepSolution.trick: As soon as you verify two options are synonyms (Rajani and Vibhavari), immediately mark (D)!
aiDeepSolution.trap: Selecting only (A) or (B) without reading all options is the most frequent blunder in BPSC exams.

questions.subject: Hindi Grammar
questions.question: What is the exact antonym (Vilom) of the word 'Aastik' (आस्तिक - Theist)?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The standard grammatical antonym of 'Aastik' is 'Naastik' (नास्तिक).

aiDeepSolution.concept: In Sanskrit/Hindi grammar, Aastik refers to one who believes in the authority of the Vedas or God, and its opposite formed by negative prefix 'Na' is Naastik.
aiDeepSolution.trick: Aastik <-> Naastik (Theist vs Atheist).
aiDeepSolution.trap: Words like 'Avishvasi' mean untrustworthy/skeptic, not theist/atheist.

questions.subject: English Grammar
questions.question:
Complete the third conditional sentence:
'If you had studied hard, you _______ the examination.'
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The correct completion is 'would have passed'.

aiDeepSolution.concept: Third Conditional (Unfulfilled past condition): Structure is: If + Past Perfect (had + V3) in the condition clause, followed by 'would have + V3' in the main result clause.
aiDeepSolution.trick: Pattern match: 'If + had studied' -> MUST pair with 'would have passed'.
aiDeepSolution.trap: Option A ('would pass') is used in Second Conditionals (If + simple past), not Third Conditionals.

questions.subject: English Grammar
questions.question:
Fill in the blank with the appropriate preposition of time:
'The train departs _______ 8:30 PM sharp.'
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Preposition 'at' is used for specific points in time on a clock.

aiDeepSolution.concept: Prepositions of Time: Use 'at' for precise clock times (at 8:30 PM, at noon), 'on' for days and dates (on Monday, on 15th August), and 'in' for longer periods (in October, in 2026).
aiDeepSolution.trick: Specific time on a clock = ALWAYS 'at'.
aiDeepSolution.trap: Do not use 'on' or 'in' with clock times.

questions.subject: 1942 Movement Bihar
questions.question: On which historic date did the 'Patna Secretariat Firing' occur during the Quit India Movement of 1942, in which 7 patriotic students attained martyrdom?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The Patna Secretariat firing took place on 11th August 1942.

aiDeepSolution.concept: On 11 August 1942, students marched to unfurl the national flag on Patna Secretariat. District Magistrate W.G. Archer ordered police firing, martyring 7 students: Umakant Prasad Sinha, Ramanand Singh, Satish Prasad Jha, Jagatpati Kumar, Devipada Choudhary, Rajendra Singh, and Ramgovind Singh.
aiDeepSolution.trick: 11 August 1942 = 7 Martyrs of Patna Secretariat (statue installed opposite Bihar Assembly).
aiDeepSolution.trap: 9th August was the launch of Quit India and arrest of top leaders; the firing happened on 11th August.

questions.subject: 1942 Movement Bihar
questions.question: Who founded the revolutionary underground guerrilla force 'Azad Dasta' in the dense forests of Nepal after escaping from Hazaribagh Central Jail on Diwali night in 1942?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Jayaprakash Narayan (JP) established 'Azad Dasta'.

aiDeepSolution.concept: JP escaped Hazaribagh Jail on 9 November 1942 along with Ramanandan Mishra, Suraj Narayan Singh, Shaligram Singh, Yogendra Shukla, and Gulab Chand Gupta. In the Terai of Nepal (Bakro Ka Tapu), he established 'Azad Dasta' with a wireless communication center led by Rammanohar Lohia.
aiDeepSolution.trick: JP + Azad Dasta + Nepal = Iconic BPSC PYQ fact.
aiDeepSolution.trap: Rammanohar Lohia was the head of its Radio and Foreign Affairs department, but the primary founder was JP.

questions.subject: Soils of Bihar
questions.question: What is the local geographical terminology for the older alluvial soil found extensively in the plains of Bihar?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Older alluvium is termed 'Bangar' (or Karail-Kewal).

aiDeepSolution.concept: Alluvial soil in Bihar is bifurcated into: (1) Bangar (Older Alluvium) — situated in upland areas beyond normal flood level, rich in clay and lime nodules (Kankar); and (2) Khadar (Newer Alluvium) — floodplains replenished annually, lighter and highly fertile.
aiDeepSolution.trick: Old = Bangar (Bhagar). New flood soil = Khadar.
aiDeepSolution.trap: Khadar is the new flood soil; Balthar is sandy-red soil found at the junction of Chhota Nagpur plateau.

questions.subject: General Science
questions.question: Pure water has a neutral pH of 7.0. What is the normal physiological pH range of healthy human arterial blood?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Normal human blood pH is slightly alkaline, ranging between 7.35 and 7.45.

aiDeepSolution.concept: Human blood pH is tightly regulated within 7.35 - 7.45 by physiological bicarbonate ($HCO_3^-$ / $H_2CO_3$) and phosphate buffer systems. A pH below 7.35 constitutes acidosis; above 7.45 is alkalosis.
aiDeepSolution.trick: Human blood is slightly basic / alkaline (average 7.4).
aiDeepSolution.trap: Choosing 6.5-6.8 would indicate fatal acidosis.

questions.subject: General Science
questions.question: Which of the following substances will turn blue litmus paper into red?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Both Vinegar (Acetic acid) and Lemon juice (Citric acid) are acidic and turn blue litmus red. Hence option (D) is correct.

aiDeepSolution.concept: Acids turn Blue litmus Red ($pH < 7$). Bases turn Red litmus Blue ($pH > 7$). Vinegar contains acetic acid and lemon juice contains citric acid. Since options A and B are both acidic, option D applies.
aiDeepSolution.trick: A (Acid) turns Blue to Red. Two correct choices -> Select (D) immediately!
aiDeepSolution.trap: Caustic soda is a strong alkali (NaOH), which turns red litmus blue.

questions.subject: Mental Ability
questions.question: If an analog clock shows 4:30, what is the exact angle formed between the hour hand and the minute hand?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The angle between the hands is 45°.

aiDeepSolution.trick: At 4:30, the minute hand is at 6 (180°), but the hour hand has moved halfway between 4 and 5 (at $120 + 15 = 135^\circ$). Angle = $180 - 135 = 45^\circ$.
aiDeepSolution.trap: Many assume the hour hand stays stationary on 4 and guess $60^\circ$ ($2 \times 30^\circ$).

questions.subject: Bihar Agriculture
questions.question: Which district of Bihar ranks highest in the commercial production of Makhana (Fox Nut / Gorgon Nut) in India and holds the GI tag?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Darbhanga and Madhubani are both premier producers; Bihar produces over 85% of global Makhana, with 'Mithila Makhana' having GI tag spanning these districts. Hence option (D) is correct.

aiDeepSolution.concept: Makhana farming is concentrated across the wetland districts of North Bihar: Darbhanga (National Research Centre for Makhana), Madhubani, Saharsa, and Purnia. Since both Darbhanga and Madhubani are top producers, option (D) is valid.
aiDeepSolution.trick: Darbhanga and Madhubani both lead in Mithila Makhana production -> BPSC Option (D).
aiDeepSolution.trap: Selecting only Darbhanga while overlooking Madhubani will lose marks on BPSC 5-option questions.

questions.subject: Indian Geography
questions.question: Through how many Indian states does the Tropic of Cancer (23.5° N latitude) pass?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The Tropic of Cancer passes through exactly 8 Indian states.

aiDeepSolution.concept: The 8 states are: Gujarat, Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, West Bengal, Tripura, and Mizoram. (Note: It does NOT pass through Bihar).
aiDeepSolution.trick: Mnemonic: 'GR MC J WB TM' (Gujarat, Rajasthan, MP, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, West Bengal, Tripura, Mizoram).
aiDeepSolution.trap: Tropic of Cancer passes through Jharkhand, which was formerly part of Bihar, but it does NOT pass through present-day Bihar.

questions.subject: Mathematics (6-8)
questions.question: What is the Lowest Common Multiple (LCM) of the fractions 2/3, 4/9, and 5/6?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The LCM of the fractions is 20/3.

aiDeepSolution.concept: Formula for LCM of Fractions: $\text{LCM}(\text{Fractions}) = \frac{\text{LCM of Numerators}}{\text{HCF of Denominators}}$.
aiDeepSolution.trick: Numerators: 2, 4, 5 -> $\text{LCM}(2, 4, 5) = 20$. Denominators: 3, 9, 6 -> $\text{HCF}(3, 9, 6) = 3$. Hence $\text{LCM} = 20/3$.
aiDeepSolution.trap: Inverting the formula (e.g. taking HCF of numerators) yields the HCF of fractions, not LCM.

questions.subject: Mathematics (6-8)
questions.question: If $3^{(x - y)} = 27$ and $3^{(x + y)} = 243$, what is the exact numerical value of $x$?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The value of x is 4.

aiDeepSolution.concept: Express in powers of 3: $27 = 3^3 \implies x - y = 3$. $243 = 3^5 \implies x + y = 5$. Adding both equations: $(x - y) + (x + y) = 3 + 5 \implies 2x = 8 \implies x = 4$.
aiDeepSolution.trick: Add exponents: $2x = 3 + 5 = 8 \implies x = 4$. $y = 1$.
aiDeepSolution.trap: Finding $y$ instead of $x$ ($y=1$ is a distractor).

questions.subject: Mathematics (6-8)
questions.source: Bihar SCERT Class 8 & BPSC TRE 1.0 PYQ
questions.question: A merchant gives a discount of 20% on the Marked Price (MP) of an article and still secures a profit of 20% on Cost Price (CP). By what percentage is the Marked Price set above the Cost Price?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The Marked Price is 50% above the Cost Price.

aiDeepSolution.concept: Standard Profit-Loss-Discount identity: $\frac{\text{MP}}{\text{CP}} = \frac{100 + \text{Profit}\%}{100 - \text{Discount}\%} = \frac{100 + 20}{100 - 20} = \frac{120}{80} = \frac{3}{2} = 1.5$.
aiDeepSolution.trick: Markup percentage = $(\frac{3}{2} - 1) \times 100 = 50\%$.
aiDeepSolution.trap: Simply adding $20\% + 20\% = 40\%$ is a false intuitive trap.

questions.subject: Science (Chemistry)
questions.question: Which carboxylic acid is injected by an ant sting that causes immediate acute burning sensation on human skin?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Ant stings contain Methanoic acid ($HCOOH$), commonly known as Formic acid.

aiDeepSolution.concept: The sting of an ant contains Methanoic acid. The burning sensation is treated and neutralized by applying mild bases such as moist baking soda ($NaHCO_3$) or calamine lotion ($ZnCO_3$).
aiDeepSolution.trick: Formica is Latin for ant -> Formic acid / Methanoic acid ($HCOOH$).
aiDeepSolution.trap: Acetic acid is in vinegar; Oxalic acid is in tomatoes and spinach.

questions.subject: Science (Biology)
questions.question: Which complex plant vascular tissue is responsible for translocating organic nutrients (primarily sucrose) synthesized in leaves to all other living tissues of the plant?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Phloem conducts synthesized food materials throughout the plant.

aiDeepSolution.concept: Xylem transports water and dissolved mineral ions upward unidirectionally from roots to leaves. Phloem conducts organic photosynthates (sucrose, amino acids) bidirectionally from source to sink via sieve tubes and companion cells (Translocation).
aiDeepSolution.trick: Phloem = Food (bidirectional). Xylem = 'Jal' / Water (unidirectional upward).
aiDeepSolution.trap: Confusing the functions of Xylem and Phloem.

questions.subject: Science (Physics)
questions.question: The physiological loudness (sound intensity) of a sound wave is directly proportional to which physical characteristic of the wave?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Loudness is directly proportional to the square of the amplitude of vibration.

aiDeepSolution.concept: Loudness is determined by the amplitude: $\text{Loudness} \propto (\text{Amplitude})^2$. If the amplitude is doubled, the loudness increases fourfold. Frequency determines the pitch/shrillness of sound.
aiDeepSolution.trick: Loudness = Amplitude squared ($A^2$). Pitch = Frequency ($f$).
aiDeepSolution.trap: Many candidates confuse loudness with pitch and mistakenly choose frequency.

questions.subject: Science (Chemistry)
questions.question: What chemical products are invariably formed in an aqueous Acid-Base Neutralization reaction?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: A neutralization reaction produces Salt and Water ($\\text{Acid} + \\text{Base} \\to \\text{Salt} + \\text{Water}$).

aiDeepSolution.concept: In an aqueous neutralization reaction, hydrogen ions ($H^+$) from the acid combine with hydroxide ions ($OH^-$) from the base to produce water molecules ($H_2O$), accompanied by the formation of an ionic salt ($e.g. \ HCl + NaOH \to NaCl + H_2O$).
aiDeepSolution.trick: Neutralization: Acid + Base -> Salt + Water (+ Heat).
aiDeepSolution.trap: Option A ('Salt only') ignores water, which is a required stoichiometric byproduct.

questions.subject: Mathematics (6-8)
questions.question: What is the total sum of the three exterior angles of any Euclidean convex triangle?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The sum of the exterior angles of any convex polygon (including a triangle) is 360°.

aiDeepSolution.concept: For any convex polygon of $n$ sides, the sum of exterior angles (one per vertex) is ALWAYS $360^\circ$ (or $2\pi$ radians), independent of the number of sides $n$. For a triangle: interior sum is $180^\circ$, exterior sum is $360^\circ$.
aiDeepSolution.trick: Exterior angle sum of ANY polygon is permanently $360^\circ$.
aiDeepSolution.trap: Students confuse interior angle sum ($180^\circ$) with exterior angle sum ($360^\circ$).

questions.subject: Science (Biology)
questions.question: In the human digestive alimentary canal, in which anatomical organ does complete digestion and final absorption of nutrients predominantly occur?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Complete chemical digestion and nutrient absorption occur in the Small Intestine.

aiDeepSolution.concept: The Small Intestine receives bile from the liver and pancreatic juice, completing the digestion of carbohydrates, proteins, and fats. Millions of microscopic villi and microvilli in the ileum/jejunum absorb digested nutrients into blood capillaries and lacteals.
aiDeepSolution.trick: Small Intestine = Site of COMPLETE digestion and maximum nutrient absorption.
aiDeepSolution.trap: The Large Intestine absorbs primarily water and electrolytes, not macronutrients.

questions.subject: Mathematics (6-8)
questions.question: The perimeter of an equilateral triangle is 45 cm. What is its exact mathematical area?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The area is (225√3)/4 cm².

aiDeepSolution.concept: Perimeter $3a = 45 \implies \text{side } a = 15$ cm. Area of equilateral triangle $= \frac{\sqrt{3}}{4} a^2 = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{4} (15^2) = \frac{225\sqrt{3}}{4}$ cm².
aiDeepSolution.trick: Side $a = 15$ cm. Area $= \frac{\sqrt{3}}{4} (225) = \frac{225\sqrt{3}}{4}$ cm² $\approx 97.43$ cm².
aiDeepSolution.trap: Forgetting the division by 4 in the equilateral area formula $\frac{\sqrt{3}}{4} a^2$.

questions.subject: Mathematics (9-10)
questions.question: What is the algebraic condition for the system of two linear equations $a_1 x + b_1 y + c_1 = 0$ and $a_2 x + b_2 y + c_2 = 0$ to possess No Solution (Parallel Lines / Inconsistent System)?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The condition for No Solution is $a_1/a_2 = b_1/b_2 \neq c_1/c_2$.

aiDeepSolution.concept: Classification of Linear Systems: (1) Unique solution (Intersecting): $a_1/a_2 \neq b_1/b_2$. (2) Infinitely many solutions (Coincident): $a_1/a_2 = b_1/b_2 = c_1/c_2$. (3) No solution (Parallel): $a_1/a_2 = b_1/b_2 \neq c_1/c_2$.
aiDeepSolution.trick: Slopes are equal ($a_1/a_2 = b_1/b_2$), but intercepts are different ($\neq c_1/c_2$) -> Parallel lines never meet.
aiDeepSolution.trap: Option C represents coincident lines with infinite solutions, not zero solutions.

questions.subject: Mathematics (9-10)
questions.question: For what numerical value of parameter 'k' will the system of linear equations $2x + 3y = 7$ and $(k - 1)x + (k + 2)y = 3k$ have Infinitely Many Solutions?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The value of k is 7.

aiDeepSolution.concept: For infinitely many solutions: $\frac{a_1}{a_2} = \frac{b_1}{b_2} = \frac{c_1}{c_2} \implies \frac{2}{k - 1} = \frac{3}{k + 2} = \frac{7}{3k}$.
aiDeepSolution.trick: Cross-multiply the first two ratios: $2(k + 2) = 3(k - 1) \implies 2k + 4 = 3k - 3 \implies k = 7$. Verify third: $\frac{2}{6} = \frac{1}{3} = \frac{7}{21}$, perfectly consistent!
aiDeepSolution.trap: Calculation slip in signs while cross-multiplying.

questions.subject: Mathematics (9-10)
questions.question: A boat's speed in still water is 15 km/h. If the speed of the water current is 3 km/h, how much time will it take for the boat to travel a distance of 36 km downstream?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The time required is 2 hours.

aiDeepSolution.concept: Downstream speed $= u + v = 15 + 3 = 18$ km/h. Upstream speed $= u - v = 15 - 3 = 12$ km/h. Time $= \text{Distance} / \text{Speed} = 36 / 18 = 2$ hours.
aiDeepSolution.trick: Downstream speed $= 15 + 3 = 18$ km/h. Time $= 36 / 18 = 2$ hours.
aiDeepSolution.trap: Using upstream speed ($36/12 = 3$ hours) is distractor Option B.

questions.subject: Mathematics (9-10)
questions.source: NCERT Exemplar Class 10 & BPSC TRE 3.0 PYQ
questions.question: What are the Cartesian coordinates of the intersection point of the two linear equations $2x + y = 6$ and $2x - y = 2$?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The intersection point coordinates are (2, 2).

aiDeepSolution.concept: Add both equations: $(2x + y) + (2x - y) = 6 + 2 \implies 4x = 8 \implies x = 2$. Substitute $x = 2$ into $2x + y = 6 \implies 2(2) + y = 6 \implies y = 2$. Point is $(2, 2)$.
aiDeepSolution.trick: Sum gives $4x = 8 \implies x = 2$. Difference gives $2y = 4 \implies y = 2$. Point is $(2, 2)$.
aiDeepSolution.trap: Plugging coordinates backwards into the option list.

questions.subject: Mathematics (9-10)
questions.question: If $x + y = 10$ and $x - y = 4$, what is the exact algebraic value of $(x^2 - y^2)$?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The value of $(x^2 - y^2)$ is 40.

aiDeepSolution.concept: Difference of Two Squares Identity: $x^2 - y^2 = (x + y)(x - y)$. Substituting the given values: $x^2 - y^2 = (10) \times (4) = 40$.
aiDeepSolution.trick: Direct identity: $10 \times 4 = 40$. Solved in 2 seconds!
aiDeepSolution.trap: Solving individually for $x=7$ and $y=3$ is unnecessary and risks arithmetic mistakes ($7^2 - 3^2 = 49 - 9 = 40$).

questions.subject: Mathematics (9-10)
questions.question: A father's current age is 3 times the age of his son. After 5 years, the father's age will be 2.5 times the age of his son. What is the current age of the father?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The father's current age is 45 years.

aiDeepSolution.concept: Let son's age be $S$, father's age $F = 3S$. After 5 years: $F + 5 = 2.5(S + 5) \implies 3S + 5 = 2.5S + 12.5 \implies 0.5S = 7.5 \implies S = 15$. Father's age $= 3 \times 15 = 45$ years.
aiDeepSolution.trick: Check options: If Father = 45, Son = 15. In 5 years: Father = 50, Son = 20. $50 / 20 = 2.5$. Perfect match!
aiDeepSolution.trap: Selecting son's age ($15$) or miscalculating the decimals.

questions.subject: Mathematics (9-10)
questions.question: The Cartesian graphs of the equations $x = 0$ and $y = -4$ represent which geometric orientation in the coordinate plane?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The lines are mutually perpendicular to each other.

aiDeepSolution.concept: The equation $x = 0$ is the Y-axis (vertical line). The equation $y = -4$ is a horizontal line parallel to the X-axis at a distance of 4 units below origin. Vertical and horizontal lines intersect at a $90^\circ$ angle and are therefore mutually perpendicular.
aiDeepSolution.trick: Y-axis ($x=0$) and Horizontal line ($y=-4$) always meet at $90^\circ$ -> Perpendicular.
aiDeepSolution.trap: Assuming $x = 0$ and $y = -4$ are parallel because both are linear constants.

questions.subject: Hindi Grammar
questions.question: Which of the following is the authentic antonym (विलोम) of 'Anurag' (अनुराग)?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The standard antonym of 'Anurag' (अनुराग) is 'Viraag' (विराग).

aiDeepSolution.concept: Standard Hindi antonym pairs: Anurag ↔ Viraag | Utkarsh ↔ Apakarsh | Aastik ↔ Nastik.
aiDeepSolution.trick: Prefix 'Vi-' is used to form the opposite: Anu-rag ⟶ Vi-rag.
aiDeepSolution.trap: Dvesh is often chosen casually, but the exact literary antonym is Viraag.

questions.subject: English Grammar
questions.question:
Choose the correct preposition to complete the sentence:
'The historic Champaran Satyagraha started _______ April 1917.'
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: We use 'in' for months and years ('in April 1917').

aiDeepSolution.concept: Preposition of time: 'In' + month/year | 'On' + specific day/date | 'At' + precise clock time.
aiDeepSolution.trick: April 1917 is a month + year ⟶ requires 'in'.
aiDeepSolution.trap: Using 'on' is only correct if an exact calendar date is provided (e.g., 'on 10th April 1917').

questions.subject: English Grammar
questions.question: Select the sentence with grammatically correct punctuation and conditional sequence:
options: If he had run fast, he would have caught the train.
If he ran fast, he will catch the train.
If he had run fast, he caught the train.
More than one of the above
questions.explanation: 'If he had run fast, he would have caught the train' correctly follows the Third Conditional format.

aiDeepSolution.concept: Third conditional formula: If + had + V3, Subject + would have + V3.
aiDeepSolution.trick: Had run ⟶ would have caught.
aiDeepSolution.trap: Mixing past simple with will.

questions.subject: Bihar Geography & Agriculture
questions.question: Which agro-climatic region and crop of Bihar received the prestigious Geographical Indication (GI) tag and accounts for over 85% of total global supply?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Mithila Makhana (Fox Nut) received the GI tag and Bihar accounts for over 85% of global makhana production.

aiDeepSolution.concept: Concentrated in Darbhanga, Madhubani, and Saharsa wetlands. Over 85% of global makhana is produced in Bihar.
aiDeepSolution.trick: Over 85% global production = Mithila Makhana.
aiDeepSolution.trap: While Shahi Litchi also has a GI tag, it accounts for a large share of India's litchi, but Mithila Makhana dominates over 85% globally.

questions.subject: Bihar Geography
questions.question: What is the average annual rainfall received by the state of Bihar?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Bihar receives an average annual rainfall between 1,000 mm and 1,200 mm, with Kishanganj receiving the highest rainfall.

aiDeepSolution.concept: Monsoon brings ~85% of total annual rainfall between June and September. Kishanganj receives the highest rainfall (~1,800 mm).
aiDeepSolution.trick: Average rainfall = ~1,100 to 1,200 mm. Maximum rainfall = Kishanganj.
aiDeepSolution.trap: Assuming very dry or ultra-heavy tropical numbers.

More than one of the above

questions.subject: NCERT Class 7–8 Mathematics

questions.subject: NCERT Class 10 Mathematics
questions.question: Which of the following geometric conditions represents a system of linear equations that has NO SOLUTION (Inconsistent)?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: A linear system has no solution (parallel lines) if and only if a1/a2 = b1/b2 ≠ c1/c2.

aiDeepSolution.concept: Parallel lines never meet, hence no common solution exists (inconsistent). This occurs when slopes are equal but intercepts differ: a1/a2 = b1/b2 ≠ c1/c2.
aiDeepSolution.trick: Equal first ratios, unequal constant ratio = Parallel (No solution).
aiDeepSolution.trap: Confusing with all three ratios being equal (coincident lines, infinite solutions).

questions.subject: NCERT Class 10 Mathematics
questions.question: What is the geometric relationship between the straight line x = 0 and the straight line y = -4 in the Cartesian coordinate plane?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: x = 0 represents the vertical Y-axis and y = -4 represents a horizontal line parallel to the X-axis. Any vertical line is perpendicular to any horizontal line.

aiDeepSolution.concept: Lines of the form x = a are vertical and lines of the form y = b are horizontal. They intersect at a right angle (90°).
aiDeepSolution.trick: x = c (vertical) ⊥ y = k (horizontal) ⟶ Always Perpendicular.
aiDeepSolution.trap: Thinking they do not intersect.

questions.subject: NCERT Class 10 Mathematics
questions.question: What is the simplified value of the trigonometric expression (sin²θ + cos²θ + tan²θ - sec²θ)?

questions.explanation: sin²θ + cos²θ = 1 and sec²θ - tan²θ = 1 (so tan²θ - sec²θ = -1). Therefore, 1 + (-1) = 0.

aiDeepSolution.concept: Fundamental identities: sin²θ + cos²θ = 1, and 1 + tan²θ = sec²θ ⟹ tan²θ - sec²θ = -1.

questions.subject: NCERT Class 10 Mathematics
questions.question: In ΔABC, if line DE is drawn parallel to side BC intersecting AB at D and AC at E (Basic Proportionality Theorem / Thales Theorem), and AD = 2 cm, DB = 3 cm, AE = 4 cm, what is the length of EC?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: By Thales Theorem, AD/DB = AE/EC ⟹ 2/3 = 4/EC ⟹ 2·EC = 12 ⟹ EC = 6 cm.

aiDeepSolution.concept: Basic Proportionality Theorem (Thales Theorem): If a line is drawn parallel to one side of a triangle, it divides the other two sides in the same ratio: AD/DB = AE/EC.
aiDeepSolution.trap: Setting AD/AB instead of AD/DB.

questions.subject: NCERT Class 10 Mathematics
questions.question: What is the discriminant (D) of the quadratic equation 2x² - 4x + 3 = 0, and what is the nature of its roots?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: D = b² - 4ac = (-4)² - 4(2)(3) = 16 - 24 = -8. Since D < 0, the equation has no real roots.

aiDeepSolution.concept: Discriminant D = b² - 4ac. If D > 0, 2 distinct real roots; if D = 0, 2 equal real roots; if D < 0, no real roots.
aiDeepSolution.trick: 16 - 24 = -8 < 0 ⟶ No real roots.
aiDeepSolution.trap: Dropping the negative sign in (-4)².

questions.subject: NCERT Class 10 Mathematics

options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: First term a = 2, common difference d = 7 - 2 = 5. a_10 = a + (10 - 1)d = 2 + 9(5) = 2 + 45 = 47.

questions.subject: NCERT Class 10 Mathematics
questions.question: A card is drawn from a well-shuffled deck of 52 playing cards. What is the probability of drawing a face card (King, Queen, or Jack)?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: There are 4 Kings, 4 Queens, and 4 Jacks, totaling 12 face cards. Probability = 12 / 52 = 3 / 13.

aiDeepSolution.concept: Total cards = 52. Face cards = 3 per suit × 4 suits = 12 cards. P = 12 / 52 = 3 / 13.
aiDeepSolution.trick: 12 / 52 simplifies by dividing numerator and denominator by 4 ⟶ 3 / 13.
aiDeepSolution.trap: Including Aces as face cards (Aces are honor cards, not face cards).
